note_15min: Open-Meteo says 15-minute data outside Europe and North America is interpolated from hourly values. Sri Lanka is outside those regions.
radiation_note: Radiation variables are the mean over the preceding interval. Temperature, humidity, cloud cover and wind are the value at the timestamp.
note: Index for one live pull. current, hourly and minutely_15 are forecast weather. Files named pv_*_simulated are pvlib output, not measured generation; their own metadata has pv_is_simulated true.
